name: Dranik Catacombs: Quarries
summary: Collapsed Dragorn excavation tunnels now corrupted by Discord and patrolled by Muramite scouts.
description: The Quarries form the uppermost layer of the Dranik Catacombs. Once used by Dragorn miners and stonecutters, the tunnels collapsed during the Muramite invasion and were later corrupted by Discord energy. Jagged stone, unstable ground, and arcane fissures dominate the terrain. Muramite scouts and beast handlers patrol the tunnels, while Discord manifestations seep through cracks in the stone. The Quarries serve as the entry point into the deeper catacombs.
